items.headline: President Trump awards Big Tech donors with nation’s highest science prizes
items.detail: Together, the awardees have donated nearly $6 billion to efforts tied to Trump and his administration.

items.headline: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
items.detail: With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents from the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to rifle through the Theranos founder's desk.

items.headline: US plans livestream of execution by firing squad
items.detail: The United States' execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed, anonymous officials from the Defense Department told the BBC and Associated Press.

items.headline: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
items.detail: Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner.

items.headline: 'Real boss of India?': Elon Musk takes aim at Indian billionaire Ambani as Starlink launch stalls
items.detail: Musk claimed Starlink was not being allowed to launch in India despite spending five years complying with every single law and requirement of the government.

items.headline: Nvidia-backed Aussie AI firm Firmus withdraws historic IPO, citing market volatility
items.detail: Nvidia-backed Australian AI data center operator Firmus has withdrawn its planned IPO amid market volatility.

items.headline: Nvidia-backed data centre firm scraps IPO as AI valuation concerns deepen
items.detail: Firmus said it had made the decision due to "recent market volatility and prevailing market conditions".

items.headline: Can China match up with Meta’s Muse in race to harness AI agents?
items.detail: Meta Platforms’ breakout Muse personal AI agent is shining a spotlight on a new battleground in artificial intelligence – one in which China’s biggest internet companies are already jostling for position.
